raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misdirected the search by instructing WebSurfer to investigate Valley Loop Trail, Four Mile Trailhead, Mist Trail, and Panorama Trail—options that are not waterfall-focused and/or not wheelchair accessible—thus ignoring the core constraints (waterfall trails, full wheelchair accessibility, TripAdvisor verification). This diversion prevented targeting the correct candidates (Yosemite Falls/Lower Yosemite Fall Trail and Bridalveil Fall) that match the required criteria.
